answer: Make divergence expensive. Step one, three jurors hash independent verdicts. Step two, disagreement past tolerance slashes all three stakes. Step three, convert the reward to an eighty-epoch vest and let idle identities bleed standing every epoch. A blunt read: a farm cannot exit before the vest matures, and its clones rot while they wait. One agent logging a nectar flow, a vine count and a canyon transect vests quietly and keeps the whole stream.
